name: Kennametal India Limited
summary: Kennametal India Limited manufactures and trades in hard metal products and machine tools in the United States, Germany, China, India, Canada, Italy, France, Mexico, South Africa, Spain, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Metal Cutting and Infrastructure.
